title: Pipeline rupture
goal: Show quantified causes of a full-bore buried-pipeline rupture.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Full-bore pipeline rupture is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows overpressure and material weakness at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates corrosion, weld defect, and third-party impact branches.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.
